text: {"lessons":["Judge trades by the business and market outlook, not just by whether a position is below its purchase price; several loss-making sales show that cost basis alone is a poor guide.","Avoid frequent, reactive switching between stocks. Set a clear reason and time horizon for each trade, and reassess it consistently.","Take profits in a measured way, but avoid letting a winning position become an excuse to ignore diversification and the long-term goal of outperforming the market."]}
